build_dictionary_from_files: build a fairseq Dictionary from a list of text files with configurable threshold and padding factor
load_dictionary_from_file: load a fairseq Dictionary from an existing dictionary file on disk
setup_task_from_args: setup a FairseqTask instance from parsed command-line arguments and optional kwargs
build_generator_for_inference: build a SequenceGenerator with beam search or sampling strategy for inference from models and args
get_batch_iterator: get an EpochBatchIterator that yields batches from a FairseqDataset with size constraints and sharding
